Mercury Stainless Steel Water Mug with Woodbase PP inside

Bring style and practicality to your everyday drinkware with the Mercury Stainless Steel Water Mug with Wood Base & PP Inside. This thoughtfully designed mug combines the durability of stainless steel with the warmth of a wooden base and the safety of a PP (polypropylene) inner lining. The result is a contemporary mug that’s both elegant and functional — perfect for water, coffee, tea, or any beverage of your choice.

Its stainless steel outer layer ensures long-lasting strength and a premium look, while the PP inside provides a food-safe, easy-to-clean surface. The wooden base adds a natural, stylish accent and protects your surfaces from heat or moisture.

Stay refreshed in style with the Mercury Stainless Steel Water Mug, designed to combine durability, functionality, and modern aesthetics. Crafted from high-quality stainless steel, this mug ensures long-lasting use while keeping your beverages at the perfect temperature. Its sleek wooden base adds a touch of sophistication, making it a standout piece on your desk, kitchen counter, or dining table.

The interior is lined with food-grade polypropylene (PP), ensuring that every sip of water, tea, or coffee is free from metallic aftertaste and safe for daily use. The PP lining also provides excellent insulation, helping to maintain your drink’s temperature for longer periods.
